translations.web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
translations.bsb: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
translations.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
translations.asv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.
